status: Prospective for the new finite-grid and scheduling experiments; retrospective harmonization for the previously published Game 1.0 and Grid Under Scarcity results.
research_question: Can one fixed execution grammar—Law, minimal sufficient State including necessary Residue, a transparent Renderer, bounded Search/Action, Phenotype, and Ledger—be instantiated in three structurally different domains without changing the grammar, while preserving exact answers under certified reductions?

domains.name: power_grid
domains.source: New finite DC thermal-memory microgrid plus previously published 14-bus scarcity study
domains.role: New exact cross-domain test and preserved external-scale baseline

domains.name: scheduling
domains.source: New finite two-machine sequence-dependent setup problem

common_tests.name: minimal_sufficient_state
common_tests.pass_condition: The full state determines legal transitions and exact objective values in the enumerated system.

common_tests.name: residue_necessity
common_tests.pass_condition: At least one pair of reachable full states shares the same visible state but differs in legal transitions, transition costs, or exact objective value because of omitted residue.

common_tests.name: certified_renderer_exactness
common_tests.pass_condition: The Renderer-reduced solver has zero exact-value mismatches against the unreduced solver over every reachable state in the stated finite test scope.

common_tests.name: computation_reduction
common_tests.pass_condition: The certified Renderer uses fewer within-domain work units than the unreduced reference on the stated test. Work units are reported by domain and are not treated as commensurate across domains.

renderer_rule: For the new finite domains, enumerate Law-permitted actions, compute their complete one-step successor and immediate objective contribution, partition actions by a future-relevant canonical successor signature, and retain one minimum-cost representative from each class. Heuristic ranking, if any, is reported separately and is never called certified pruning.
falsification_conditions: Any exact objective-value mismatch caused by the certified Renderer within an enumerated scope.
A claimed sufficient state that maps one represented state to more than one Law-defined legal-transition set or exact value.
No reduction in the declared within-domain work unit after Renderer overhead is exposed.
A need to alter the common execution grammar rather than only the domain Law, state variables, Renderer channels, and objective.
Failure to reproduce the published Game baseline invariants from its machine-readable ledger.
interpretation_boundary: Passing three finite-domain tests supports portability of the execution architecture; it does not prove universal applicability.
Residue stores present constraint information required for correct transitions. It is not a prediction of a pre-existing future.
Historical Game and Grid results are preserved with their original scope and are not re-labelled as prospectively preregistered results.
Cross-domain reduction percentages are descriptive within domains because their work units differ.
